items.qa: Source hashes, self-contained GLB structure, complete-object framing and upright orientation verified. Front, side and rear renders inspected: two adult figures, integral marble base, no captured room, no gross missing surfaces. Community photogrammetry has softer facial detail than an institutional high-resolution scan.
